description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_get (line 60-65) builds 'not_found: Vec<Value>' by mapping |id| Value::String(id.clone()). The id is a String, so Value::String(id.clone()) is used. The idiomatic form is Value::String(id.to_owned()) since id is already &String — .clone() on a String calls to_owned semantically. Additionally the entire not_found list is built then conditionally wrapped in Value::Array — the same pattern as all other handlers — but here specifically the individual .map(|id| Value::String(id.clone())) can be replaced with .map(|id| json!(id)) which is both terser and avoids the explicit type. This is a minor clippy-level issue but it is inconsistent with the snippet.rs not_found (line 70) which uses id.as_ref().to_owned().
title: VacationResponse not_found uses Vec<Value::String> rather than Vec<String>
